title: Mega Millions Hits $740M - Get Tickets Now!
heading: Weekend Lottery Roundup
description: Explore lottery opportunities this week! Mega Millions hits $740 million, Powerball $112 million, and the Euromillions Superdraw.
author: Lotto Express Marketing
body_html:
There are amazing opportunities to explore for our lottery spend this week. American Mega Millions continues to climb to astronomical heights. American Powerball is the latest game to hit the nine-figure milestone. And its not too early to plan for the long awaited Euromillions Superdraw.

The excitement for this Friday’s Mega Millions draw is at an all-time high as the jackpot reaches an estimated $740 million! With no ticket matching all six numbers from Tuesday’s draw, the prize has rolled over, making this jackpot the seventh largest in Mega Millions history. The jackpot has been rolling over without a winner since June 4. All eyes are on the upcoming September 6 drawing. Will this be the draw the jackpot gets taken down? Or will the rollover trend continue as we march towards a billion?

This jackpot isn’t the only prize up for grabs—Tuesday’s draw alone created over 1.5 million winning tickets across all other prize tiers, including two $1 million winners. As the jackpot continues to grow, so do the number of winners at other levels. Don’t miss your chance to play for one of the largest prizes in the game’s history!

$112 Million American Powerball Jackpot

There’s no time to lose with this American Powerball jackpot ready for a new jackpot winner at any moment. American jackpots are more fun to play for when they are high. The American Powerball jackpot presently sits atop the nine-figure threshold at $112 Million.

Secure your American Powerball plays at LottoExpress.com today!

Euromillions Superdraw Around the Corner

Friday 27th September marks the date for the next Euromillions Superdraw.

September 27th will mark the fourth preannounced Superdraw of 2024. The Division 1 jackpot on this date will be an astounding €130 million regardless of whether there was a carryover from the preceding Euromillions draw.

Presale tickets are now available at Lotto Express. Don’t miss your chance to be part of this thrilling event and aim for the life-changing Division 1 Jackpot Prize.

Reserve your Superdraw play today!
